lines.en: Every step I take is a drumbeat.
I walk heavily and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 我的装甲边缘刮着碎石。
lines.en: My armor's edge scrapes the gravel.

lines.zh: 我把身体偏过去，避开拱门。
lines.en: I tilt to clear the arch.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌落下去，尘土扑起。
lines.en: My sole lands and dust bursts up.
I shift along inch by inch.

lines.zh: 我背上的炮管随着走晃动。
lines.en: The barrels on my back sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可谁也拦不住。
lines.en: I'm slow, but nothing stops me.

lines.zh: 我从瓦砾上踏过去，全都平了。
lines.en: I walk the rubble flat.

lines.zh: 我身上的重装发出低鸣。
lines.en: My heavy plating groans.
I stand like a small tower.
My barrels turn slowly.
I'm running a last check.
I hear the turret alarm.
My fuel smells strong.
My heat sinks steam in the rain.
I'm counting how long the ground holds.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift one foot.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，随时能启动。
lines.en: My joints creak, ready to start.
My armor is all patches.

lines.zh: 我在等放出我的那个人。
lines.en: I wait for whoever released me.
Current runs through my joints.
I lower myself slowly.
The soil here is too loose.

lines.zh: 我把左臂抬起来，试了试。
lines.en: I lift my left arm and test it.
My core is warming slowly.

lines.zh: 在我膝盖高度，你像根螺栓。
lines.en: At my knee height, you look like a bolt.
I turn my barrels away.
You're standing at the edge of my shadow.
Have you come to test me?
My armor faces you. Don't be afraid.
Ten steps back and I'll talk.

lines.zh: 这个高度，我低头很费劲。
lines.en: At this height, looking down is an effort.

lines.zh: 你的弩箭，我听见上弦声了。
lines.en: I heard you crank that crossbow.
My eyes are two lenses.
How do you plan to deal with me?
I read heat on you.

lines.zh: 没有队友跟着，省了我不少事。
lines.en: No squad with you; that saves me work.
Another dent in my armor.
Readings jump. It's fine.
Something shattered in my joint.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面陷下去。
lines.en: I step back and the ground caves.
Black smoke comes from my vents.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我核心一颤。
lines.en: That jolted my core.
I rebalance myself.
The armor still holds.

lines.zh: 我听见内部有零件松动。
lines.en: I hear parts working loose inside.
A few more and I'll come apart.
I want that power cell.
You've set the ammunition down.
That much fuel would carry me a while.
I angle toward the heat.
Give me a little and I won't move.

lines.zh: 那副机甲的零件很不错。
lines.en: That frame's parts are good stock.

lines.zh: 能量罐空了，我得靠近补给。
lines.en: My energy cell is empty; I must come closer.

lines.zh: 这东西能补上我的缺口。
lines.en: This can fill my gap.
I take a step and the ground sounds.

lines.zh: 你的东西在发光，我看见了。
lines.en: Your gear glows; I see it.
You hit me and give three or four steps.

lines.zh: 我的护甲把你的手弹开。
lines.en: My plate bounces your hand away.

lines.zh: 我侧身，还是占了半条路。
lines.en: I turn aside and still fill half the path.

lines.zh: 别推，我退了会压坏东西。
lines.en: Don't push; if I step back I'll crush something.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，你的骨头在响。
lines.en: We collide and your bones creak.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀顶住倒下的梁。
lines.en: I brace a falling beam with my shoulder.
My foot scrapes your leg.
That didn't even make me sway.
I shift half a step to make room.
You stand pressed against my leg.

lines.zh: 另一台重装停在我对面。
lines.en: Another heavy unit halts across from me.

lines.zh: 我们的装甲碰出一声闷响。
lines.en: Our plates meet with a dull clang.
Its barrels are wider than mine.
We exchange fire parameters.
Two heavies side by side is tight.
It's lost more paint than I.
Together we seal the passage.
Its core frequency is steady.
We're both good at holding still.

lines.zh: 指令来的时候，我们会一起动。
lines.en: When the order comes, we move together.
I clamp onto a shell.
I'll keep this armor plate.
I bend and pick up the power cell.
In my hand it feels like a pebble.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进背部的槽里。
lines.en: I slot it into my back.
This can still be repaired.
I'm taking it. Hands off.
I lift it and weigh it.
It's hot; I hand it to the other grip.
These will be useful.

lines.zh: 我的炮口转过来，对准你。
lines.en: My barrels swing onto you.
Target in field of fire.
I plant my feet in the soil.
All my plates close up.
You touched the summoning core, didn't you.
Fire control online.
You've backed into the open. Good.
My weight is my advantage.
There's no cover in this stretch.
I shift weight off my front foot.
Your position is locked.
Don't count on outrunning a shell.
Heat sinks wide open.
You still have time to withdraw.
I raise my left arm at you.
This will be a long fight.
I have fuel enough.
My armor plates lock tight.
I've waited far too long for this fight.
The fight starts now.

lines.zh: 我整台压着地面推过去。
lines.en: I grind forward, weight against the earth.
You change direction; I turn the barrels.
I herd you toward open ground.

lines.zh: 提灯的光被我的肩甲切断了。
lines.en: My pauldron cuts off the lantern light.

lines.zh: 三步半，我的炮口抬了两度。
lines.en: Three and a half steps; my barrel lifts two degrees.
Your cover won't stop heavy guns.
The ground under me starts to crack.
I won't tire. You will.
I spread my feet and brace.
You're retreating. I see it.
My barrel turns faster than you.
I ranged this ground beforehand.
Hide behind stone and the stone breaks.

lines.zh: 火控雷达把你框在中央。
lines.en: My targeting radar frames you in the center.
Cooling complete. Ready to fire.
You're not fast enough to shake me.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，减小受弹面。
lines.en: I turn side-on to shrink my profile.
You stand out there.
You have three seconds left.
I press the trigger halfway.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下，土都翻起来。
lines.en: My fist falls and the earth turns up.
This kick sweeps you back several paces.

lines.zh: 我的前臂压住你的肩膀。
lines.en: My forearm presses your shoulder down.

lines.zh: 你退了，地面留了一道沟。
lines.en: You retreat, leaving a furrow.
My barrels swing across and hit you.
You block, and your wrist shakes.
I press you into the rubble.
I pulled that blow by half.
The impact leaves your ears ringing.
I raise my arm to press again.
You're still standing. That surprises me.
My joint temperature is up.
You've backed downhill; I can see you.

lines.zh: 液压杆压下去，地面裂了。
lines.en: The hydraulic ram drives down; the ground splits.

lines.zh: 地面先塌了一块，我站起来。
lines.en: The ground gives way, and I rise.
The summoning item flashes.

lines.zh: 我的炮管从土里伸出来。
lines.en: My barrels rise out of the soil.

lines.zh: 核心石碎片亮了，我才动。
lines.en: The core shard lights up, and only then do I move.

lines.zh: 空气被我的重量压得发闷。
lines.en: The air thickens under my weight.
Alarms sound across the field.
My startup is low and long.
I straighten up out of the wreckage.
This place needs a heavy gun.
My plates close up piece by piece.
I grind the rubble underfoot.

lines.zh: 这一带的所有东西都在抖。
lines.en: Everything here is shaking.
My core gives a hum.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方被运来。
lines.en: I was hauled here from far away.

lines.zh: 我落地的响动能传几里。
lines.en: My landing carries for miles.

lines.zh: 机甲的启动音，在空地上响。
lines.en: A mech's startup tone sounds in the empty field.

lines.zh: 排气口吐出白气，我站起来。
lines.en: My vents exhale white steam as I rise.
My barrels cover the clearing.
I'm here. Don't block me.
Startup complete. Ready to fight.
Fire runs down my paint.
I crash down and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的腿，我动不了。
lines.en: Water rises past my legs and I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得滑了半米。
lines.en: The blast slides me half a meter.

lines.zh: 一枚弹打进了我的肩缝。
lines.en: A round lodges in my shoulder seam.

lines.zh: 法术让我的传感器一片白。
lines.en: That spell whites out my sensors.

lines.zh: 燃料见底，炮口垂了下去。
lines.en: Fuel is low; my barrels sag.

lines.zh: 雷劈在装甲上，我全身一跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits my plate and my whole body jumps.
The void eats the ground under my feet.
